metadata.title: Platform DNS Caching and TTL Behavior

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing DNS caching behavior and TTL semantics to ensure correctness, consistency, and recoverability.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: DNS cache management, TTL enforcement, and resolver consistency mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern governing how DNS responses are cached without introducing stale, inconsistent, or unsafe resolution behavior.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: DNS caching and TTL behavior depend on controlled resolution and recursion paths.

metadata.remarks: Platform DNS Caching and TTL Behavior defines expectations for how DNS responses are cached and how long they remain valid. It ensures that caching behavior supports correctness, security, and operational recovery without embedding enforcement or policy decisions.

components.title: DNS TTL Enforcement
components.description: Ensures DNS time-to-live (TTL) values are honored consistently by platform resolvers.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence or misdirection caused by stale or improperly retained DNS records.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle enforcement of cached information based on declared validity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS responses are cached only for their declared validity period to preserve integrity.

components.title: DNS Cache Consistency
components.description: Ensures DNS caches behave consistently across platform resolvers.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Inconsistent resolution results caused by divergent caching behavior.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Consistency controls to prevent divergent or conflicting cached responses.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Resolution services enforce consistent behavior across redundant components.

components.title: DNS Negative Caching Behavior
components.description: Controls how non-existent or failed DNS resolutions are cached.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Service degradation or denial caused by prolonged negative caching.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Bounded caching of negative responses to support recovery.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS caching supports recovery from transient resolution failures.
